description: DeathBan is a Fabric Server mod that brings a twist to Hardcore Minecraft multiplayer. Upon death, players are automatically banned from the server for a fixed period of time (default 1 hour), forcing them to value life and face severe consequences. It’s not permanent elimination, but a structured, punitive suspension. Simple but robust
